verdict.rationale: Shortwave's docs say its AI assistant can "check your calendar" and that the AI connects to Calendar "without ever leaving your inbox." That supports viewing calendar information indirectly through the AI from within the email client. There is no evidence of a native calendar view, responding to invites, or creating events, and none of this is independently corroborated. Missing for 10: native in-client calendar view, RSVP/respond-to-invite capability, event creation, hands-on or independent corroboration.
